nom: Well People Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen Serum Broad Spectrum SPF 34

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the texture is too light to manage extremely dry patches for one, while others describe it as hydrating and creamy enough to skip a moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation, burning, or breakouts, though one with sensitive combination skin experienced itchiness and irritation during drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as creamy, hydrating, and non-breakout-inducing, comparing it to a tinted moisturizer.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early thirties calls it well-suited to slightly mature skin, citing the smooth glide and lightweight feel.

concerns.aging: Only a single mention ties the product to mature skin, noting it glides on smoothly and suits early signs of aging; no broader anti-aging effect is described.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe it as hydrating enough to replace a moisturizer, though one says it is not sufficient for extremely dry patches around the nose and chin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with an autoimmune condition causing rashes reports no reaction; another with sensitive skin reports it burned her eyes was avoided and felt no eye irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports skin felt irritated and itchy through the drying process; others with compromised or reactive skin report no burning or stinging.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the sunscreen does not clog pores, and one gave it to her daughter specifically to help reduce breakouts with good results; no reviewer reports worsened acne.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe no new breakouts and mention it works well on acne-prone skin; no dissent on blemishes is reported.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers say it does not make skin feel oily or greasy despite mineral formulation; no reports of increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: What I like about this sunscreen serum is that there is no fragrance and/or the fragrance is very subtle. The application was smooth after my toner and other serums; however, my skin felt irritated and itchy throughout its drying process every time. The sunscreen serum says it is a good base/primer for makeup, although I did not experience this. I used this as a standalone without additional moisturizer or my usual makeup primer, and my makeup did not last throughout the day per usual if I would have used makeup primer. I like the SPF content but would not use this as a standalone moisturizer or makeup primer. I believe my sensitive combination skin just did not react well to this sunscreen serum.

extraits.titre: This is the fragrance free MVP
extraits.texte: I like how light the texture is although its not sufficient for my dry skin right now. I hate fragrance in my facial products and I couldn't detect any in this one. I usually have a problem with experiencing a burning sensation when I use other sunscreens except for the 2 others I currently use and I didn't experience any with this one. Great overall product just not sufficient for the extremely dry patches I have around my nose and chin
I am greatly surprised about this product, it is great for all types of skin. I have super sensitive and acne prone skin and this sunscreen works very well and causes no clogged poors.
Excellent product if you have dry /combo skin with goodness of SPF. It feels like tinted moisturizer on the skin.

First of all , I never expected a full size sample. Thank u so much . And to top it , it is very hydrating. First felt a little sticky but that feeling goes away in 5 min . I have combination sensitive skin . No breakouts yet . Has a bit of medicinal smell bcz of no fragrance but u get used to it . Maybe bcz im used to a light fragrance in all my products

I really like this sunscreen! It is very lightweight and easily spreads across the skin without leaving a white tint like a lot of mineral sunscreens do. It has also been very friendly with my skin (very acne-prone but also dry). A little goes a longgg way so I know it'll also last me. Can't wait for more!

This product is amazing. I have sensitive skin and most SPF products irritate it, make me oily and cause break outs. This serum smells so good, gives me a beautiful glow and has the SPF benefits. Makeup goes on very easily over this as well.
